site.audience: aspiring and practicing software developers, data scientists, and tech learners

brief.title: OpenLearnHub — Free Coding Tutorials & Curriculum
brief.one_liner: A nonprofit education platform offering free programming tutorials, certifications, and a structured coding curriculum.
brief.goal: Provide a hub for free coding education with a blog of expert-written tutorials, a structured learning curriculum, tag-based article browsing, and a donation page to support the nonprofit mission.

pages.objective: Display the latest programming tutorials in a card grid layout with featured article, tag labels, author info, and timestamps.
Present the structured learning curriculum with categorized certification paths, daily coding challenges, language courses, and interview preparation resources.
Encourage donations by showcasing impact stats, supporter benefits, current initiatives, and providing a donation amount selector with FAQ accordion.
Display all articles tagged with AI, showing the tag name, post count, related popular tags, and a grid of article cards.
Display all articles tagged with Web Scraping, showing the tag name, post count, related popular tags, and a grid of article cards.

navigation.trigger: Click #web scraping tag on article card

interactions.expected: Mobile navigation menu expands showing Forum, Curriculum, and Donate links
Selected amount is highlighted and donation description text updates to reflect the chosen amount

interactions.trigger: Click on a FAQ question item
interactions.expected: The answer expands below the question; clicking again collapses it

interactions.trigger: Click Load More Articles button at bottom of article grid
interactions.expected: Additional article cards are loaded and appended to the grid
